integrity: Exact Gaussian-sum result and two-sided exponent bounds are supported by a self-contained proof; executable checks are supplementary, not a certificate for all dimensions.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite field; at least two distinct ground-field eigenvalues; every scalar eigenspace has dimension >=2 for the uniform sharp law; no nonsplit or nonsemisimple operators are treated. Computation checks use small prime fields; independent assessment absent.
title: Exponential near-modularity in split metabelian Lie algebras
